name: Hydrocortisone / Chloramphenicol / Benzocaine Otic Solution 10 ml 1 Piece
description: This combination of active ingredients in an ear solution is used to treat otitis externa, an infection of the outer ear that causes pain, inflammation, itching, and irritation. Treatment with ear drops must be prescribed by a doctor, who will also indicate the appropriate dosage and duration. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
